question: Which prespecified fibrosis-related genes differ across nine whole-liver RNA libraries, and are directions sensitive to filtering or sample removal?
scope: Exploratory reanalysis of author development data, not independent validation or drug efficacy
target_rationale: First3 are article hypotheses; remaining5 are prespecified matrix/activation/remodelling context, not drug effects

qc.source: author HSC R script lines33-37; same thresholds for nine samples; independently implemented, not author Seurat pipeline replay

aggregation: Gene-count sums per library before QC and after stated gene/cell QC. log2(1+1e6*gene_sum/library_total). Samples, never cells, are replicates. No inferred cell labels.
statistics: Difference of mean log2(CPM+1); full six-library label enumeration20, two-sided abs-statistic; BH across16 gene/contrast tests per QC branch; minimum possible two-sided p=0.1; conditional on exchangeability, not confirmed by design metadata
sensitivity: Nine leave-one-library-out-per-group contrasts (2vs2), min/max. Descriptive stable direction requires all nine strictly same sign as full contrast and both QC branches same sign. No efficacy acceptance threshold.
limitations: batch, pooling and animal-to-library bijection not yet independently confirmed
separate sacrifice groups, not repeated measures
cell composition and fixed probe coverage confounding
author-selected target genes, not independent discovery
no collagen quantity/clearance measurements or pharmacological intervention in these9libraries
verification: positive integer counts, coordinate bounds, exact nnz, unique coordinates, feature/barcode identities
synthetic parser and statistical oracle tests
deterministic aggregate replay; raw matrices not needlessly repeated
